# Exact Source Fixtures

Generated from the five pinned public PR heads using the read-only
`scripts/source_stack_fixtures.go` recorder. Archives are generated by `git archive`
from the exact original objects. JSON retains observed public PR, commit-contributor
and review records; native sources additionally retain their actual authenticated
assignment and registered artifact, never reconstructed native history. No private
QA report body or credential belongs here. Synthetic owner decisions and renewed
reports in tests are NEW test authority, not claims of historical approval.

Regeneration requires the original Git objects, an own authenticated GitHub App
and own scoped master read access. It does not admit fixtures, modify PRs, create
tasks, retarget, merge, install or activate anything. Tests consume these files
without network or live provider access. Do not refresh a drifting fixture silently.
